_comment: Each step of the estate inventory, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls whose statements it supports and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators. Every control-to-KSI pairing here is one the workbook's kits already record, none new: AC-2, CM-8 and IA-4 to KSI-PIY-GIV and KSI-IAM-SNU, and IA-5 to KSI-IAM-SNU (examples/non-person-identity config/requirements-ch11.json, as examples/sql-server-identity cites it); CM-8 to KSI-PIY-GIV (examples/platform-host); AC-2 to KSI-IAM-AAM (examples/app-modernization); AC-6 to KSI-IAM-ELP (examples/azure-security, examples/platform-host); CA-7 to KSI-MLA-EVC and AU-9 to KSI-MLA-OSM (examples/provider-notices, examples/platform-host). KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with what its providers report against them and doesn't report KSIs itself. Which step supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides.
